mentions.name: AI chat-with-page Chrome extension
mentions.description: A lightweight Chrome extension (under 1 MB, with over 600,000 downloads) that lets users chat with the current page, draft emails and messages, fix grammar, translate, and summarize pages. It supports models from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic, including the option to use your own API key.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a lightweight (<1mb) chrome extension (with over 600,000 downloads) that lets you chat with page, draft emails and messages, fix grammar, translate, summarize page, etc.. You can use models from OpenAl, Google, and Anthropic.

Yes, you can use your own API key as well.
